record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Let X=prod_i X_i be a product of T0 spaces. If each A_i subset X_i is well-filtered determined, meaning it is Topw-determined where Topw is the category of well-filtered spaces, must the product subset prod_i A_i be well-filtered determined?

evidence.quote: Question 5.23. ([51]) Let X = i∈I Xi be the product space of a family {Xi : i ∈ I} of T0 spaces. If each Ai ⊆ Xi (i ∈ I) is well-filtered determined, must the product set i∈I Ai be well-filtered determined?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbf{Top}_0$ denote the category of $T_0$ topological spaces with continuous maps. For a $T_0$ space $X$, let $\mathcal{O}(X)$ be its lattice of open sets and let $\mathrm{Irr}_c(X)$ denote the set of closed irreducible subsets of $X$. A $T_0$ space $X$ is called well-filtered if, whenever $\{K_i\}_{i\in I}$ is a filtered family of compact saturated subsets of $X$ (i.e. each $K_i$ is the intersection of its open neighborhoods, and the family is directed under reverse inclusion) and $U$ is an open set with $\bigcap_{i\in I} K_i \subseteq U$, there exists $i_0\in I$ with $K_{i_0}\subseteq U$. Let $\mathbf{Top}_w$ denote the full subcategory of $\mathbf{Top}_0$ consisting of all well-filtered spaces.

For a $T_0$ space $X$ and a nonempty subset $A\subseteq X$, $A$ is said to be well-filtered determined (or $\mathbf{Top}_w$-determined) if for every well-filtered space $Y$ and every continuous map $f\colon X\to Y$, there exists a (necessarily unique) point $y_A\in Y$ such that $\overline{f(A)} = \overline{\{y_A\}}$.

Let $\{X_i\}_{i\in I}$ be a family of $T_0$ spaces and form the product space $X=\prod_{i\in I} X_i$ with the product topology. Suppose that for each $i\in I$, a subset $A_i\subseteq X_i$ is well-filtered determined in $X_i$.

Question: Must the product subset $\prod_{i\in I} A_i \subseteq X$ be well-filtered determined in $X$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed among open questions in recent surveys on well-filtered and sober spaces. Searches for "well-filtered determined" product subsets did not return any paper announcing a resolution; related results concern products of well-filtered spaces themselves (known to be well-filtered) and open well-filtered analogues, but the specific question on products of well-filtered determined subsets appears still open.

status_evidence.title: On T0 spaces determined by well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces the notion of well-filtered determined subsets and lists open problems on their behavior under products.
status_evidence.claim: The notion of well-filtered determined (Top_w-determined) subset is introduced, with the product question raised as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Further Studies on Open Well-filtered Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses related open problems regarding products of (open) well-filtered spaces and determined subsets.
status_evidence.claim: Related product problems on well-filtered-type properties remain unresolved in the literature.
